parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.name as project_name, p.project_type, p.budget_target, p.location_city, p.location_province, p.property_type, p.property_area_m2, p.urgency, p.current_phase, p.started_at, p.target_completion, c.name as client_name, (SELECT row_to_json(b.*) FROM briefings b WHERE b.project_id = p.id AND b.status = 'approved' ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as briefing, (SELECT row_to_json(d.*) FROM design_options d WHERE d.project_id = p.id AND d.is_selected = true LIMIT 1) as design_option, (SELECT row_to_json(ce.*) FROM cost_estimates ce WHERE ce.project_id = p.id ORDER BY ce.version DESC LIMIT 1) as cost_estimate, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('trade_type', tr.trade_type, 'scope_description', tr.scope_description) ORDER BY tr.trade_type) FROM trade_requests tr WHERE tr.project_id = p.id AND tr.status = 'prepared') as trade_assignments, (SELECT row_to_json(pp.*) FROM project_plans pp WHERE pp.project_id = p.id ORDER BY pp.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as project_plan, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('category', mi.category, 'name', mi.name, 'brand', mi.brand, 'quality_tier', mi.quality_tier) ORDER BY mi.category) FROM material_items mi WHERE mi.project_id = p.id AND mi.status = 'approved' LIMIT 20) as approved_materials, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('key', pi.key, 'value', pi.value, 'agent_name', pi.agent_name) ORDER BY pi.created_at) FROM project_intelligence pi WHERE pi.project_id = p.id) as intelligence_entries FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.id = $1::uuid

INSERT INTO memory_cases (project_id, project_type, location_zone, property_type, area_m2, summary, scope_summary, decisions_made, cost_estimated, duration_estimated_days, trades_used, materials_notable, lessons_learned, patterns, tags) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5::numeric, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, $9::numeric, $10::integer, $11::jsonb, $12::jsonb, $13::jsonb, $14::jsonb, $15::text[]) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO project_intelligence (project_id, agent_name, key, value) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_memory', 'memory_captured', $2::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (project_id, agent_name, key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = NOW()

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Parse Memory Response').first().json.project_id, JSON.stringify({memory_case_id: $input.first().json.id, lessons_count: JSON.parse($('Parse Memory Response').first().json.lessons_learned_json).length, patterns_count: JSON.parse($('Parse Memory Response').first().json.patterns_json).length})] }}

parameters.query: SELECT content FROM agent_prompts WHERE agent_name = 'agent_memory' AND prompt_type = 'system' AND is_active = true LIMIT 1
UPDATE memory_cases SET embedding = $1::vector, embedding_text = $2 WHERE id = $3::uuid RETURNING id
